name: Knox County Public Library Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at library events. Teens and adults can work at the Children's Festival of Reading. That means booths, stages, crafts, face painting and setup. They can also work at Imagination Library sign up booths and events.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older. Volunteers under 18 need a parent's approval. You must have a library card in good standing.
duration: At least 3 hours of service a month
how_to_apply: Print the General Volunteer Application. Hand it in at the library where you want to work.
notes: The policy page says exceptions to the age 14 rule may be made for short projects such as Scout requirements. Volunteers of any age may not work at public service desks or use staff computers. In-library tasks like shelving are listed for adults only.
